name: Groove Sales Engagement
description: Groove by Clari is an enterprise sales-engagement and prospecting platform for email, calendar, and CRM workflows, automated multichannel Flows and playbooks, AI-assisted outreach, buyer signals, activity capture, analytics, and Salesforce-centered revenue work.
agentUseSummary: Clari publishes Groove product documentation, selected joint-customer partner integrations, and platform-level API messaging, but it does not publish a supported Groove-specific third-party authentication, endpoint, schema, webhook, or application-registration contract. Relay therefore does not capture Clari, Groove, Google, Microsoft, or Salesforce credentials, automate private applications or add-ins, use the unrelated GrooveHQ helpdesk API, or expose agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered until Clari publishes a supported, contract-compatible Groove third-party workspace API.

providerSetup.blocker: Clari does not publish a Groove-specific third-party API, authorization and app-distribution contract, endpoint and schema reference, or webhook contract; documented Groove connections are provider-operated or selected joint-customer partner integrations.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Clari publishes a stable Groove-specific third-party API with explicit authentication, permissions, schemas, distribution terms, revocation, and bounded non-outreach reads suitable for Relay.

evidence.supports: Official product material identifies Groove as Clari's sales-engagement and prospecting product for automated workflows, email, calendar, CRM, buyer signals, analytics, and Salesforce-centered revenue work, without publishing a third-party Groove application contract.

Official product tour describes AI-assisted outreach, multichannel Flows, buyer signals, workflow automation, email and calendar activity, and CRM data capture, but does not provide third-party authentication, endpoints, schemas, or webhooks.

Clari describes platform-level public APIs and data ingestion alongside a curated integration ecosystem; the page does not publish a Groove-specific developer contract or general Groove application-registration path.

Official Nooks integration material describes a selected partner integration for joint Groove customers, enabled in Nooks and supported through Clari's partner network, rather than a generally available Groove third-party API contract.

Official privacy material describes Groove processing CRM, contact, email, calendar, and Google API data, including Gmail compose and modify access, reinforcing the decision not to automate private surfaces or capture credentials without a bounded supported contract.
